failure: Japanese/Chinese navigation and Exit buttons displayed missing-glyph boxes while the title rendered correctly.
cause: The control-specific font override used only Pretendard/NotoSans and omitted the CJK fallback faces present in the native UI font stack.
fix: Use var(--inzoi-font-ui) directly on navigation, Exit and restore controls. No font assets or translated data changed.

checks.scope: UI-only patch; the previous full runtime suite remains the recorded runtime baseline. Font-stack checks do not establish native glyph rendering.

author_acceptance.scope: Author confirmation of the requested Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese navigation/Exit glyph checks; not a native-speaker review of the translations.
